verdict.rationale: Jira ships an AI layer (Rovo), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product, but the pack has no evidence that Jira or Rovo can plug in external MCP servers and use their tools. The official Atlassian MCP server (jira-probe-3) is the server role, exposing Jira to other agents, and does not count toward this client story. Rovo's connections to third-party apps and the Marketplace integrations are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
